description: This Java class defines an HTTP route builder for the '/search/things' endpoint in an Eclipse Ditto gateway service. It sets up routes for searching and counting 'things' with various query parameters, and constructs the corresponding request handlers using Akka HTTP directives.

classes.name: ThingSearchRoute
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractRoute, responsible for building Akka HTTP routes for the '/search/things' endpoint, including counting and searching 'things' with various query parameters.

methods.name: ThingSearchRoute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the route builder with actor references, configuration, and header translation.

methods.name: buildSearchRoute
methods.description: Builds and returns the complete route for '/search/things' based on the request context and headers.

methods.name: countThings
methods.description: Handles the '/search/things/count' route, processing optional filters and namespaces to count matching 'things'.

methods.name: searchThings
methods.description: Handles the '/search/things' route, supporting multiple query parameters for searching 'things'.

methods.name: thingSearchParameterOptional
methods.description: Initiates processing of optional search parameters, compiling them into a map for route handling.

methods.name: thingSearchParameterOptionalImpl
methods.description: Recursive implementation that accumulates optional query parameters into a map and applies the route logic once all are processed.

methods.name: calculateFilter
methods.description: Extracts the 'filter' string from optional parameter, returning null if absent.

methods.name: calculateNamespaces
methods.description: Parses and returns a set of namespace strings from the optional parameter, splitting by comma.

methods.name: calculateOptions
methods.description: Converts a comma-separated options string into a list of options.
